# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy noted for his big, round face and small blue eyes. His ears are particularly objectionable and stick out like flaps, despite his attempts to train them otherwise.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon is a very serious young man who intends to become a minister. He harbours a personal fear that he will fail in English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_

## Traits

## History

During his earlier school years, Moody Spurgeon MacPherson got into a fight with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) and was beaten after claiming that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs regarding her recitations. After graduating from Queen's, he worked as a schoolteacher until his mother decided it was time for him to give up teaching and focus on studying for the ministry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)_
